cases.quantity: NAFEMS T3: temperature at x = 0.08 m, t = 32 s
cases.source: S1 (Abaqus T3) + S2 (MOOSE, git) + S3 (FeenoX test 36.6 +/- 0.05) + S4 (FEATool T_ref 36.6)
cases.derivation: eigenfunction expansion (20000 terms) of u_t = a u_xx with u(0)=0, u(L)=100 sin(pi t/40), u(x,0)=0; a = k/(rho cp)
cases.note: the analytic series gives 36.6031 degC, so the quoted 36.60 is confirmed to 4 digits; MOOSE coarse linear meshes are 10 % high

cases.quantity: NAFEMS T4: steady temperature at (0.6, 0.2) m
cases.source: generator (separation of variables) + S3 (FeenoX 18.3) + S4 (FEATool 18.3) + S6 (COMSOL 18.25, search)
cases.derivation: T = sum C_n cos(b_n x) Y_n(y)/Y_n(0); b tan(b W) = h/k; C_n = T0 (sin(bW)/b)/(W/2 + sin(2bW)/(4b)); 400 terms
cases.note: settles the rounding question of the gap list: 18.2538 rounds to 18.3 (NAFEMS) and 18.25 (COMSOL)

cases.quantity: NAFEMS T2 (FeenoX statement): temperature of the radiating face
cases.derivation: (T - T0) k / l + eps sigma (T^4 - Tinf^4) = 0, bisection
cases.note: sigma = 5.67e-8 as in the problem statement; the exact SI value 5.670374419e-8 shifts T by the amount shown

cases.quantity: semi-infinite solid after a step in surface temperature
cases.derivation: T = Ts + (Ti - Ts) erf(x / (2 sqrt(alpha t)))

cases.quantity: lumped-capacitance sphere temperature at t
cases.derivation: T = Tinf + (Ti - Tinf) exp(-t/tau), tau = rho c (d/6) / h

cases.quantity: Biot number of the lumped sphere (validity Bi < 0.1)
cases.derivation: Bi = h (V/A) / k, V/A = d/6

cases.quantity: pin fin efficiency, adiabatic tip
cases.derivation: eta = tanh(mL)/(mL), m = sqrt(4h/(k d))

cases.quantity: view factor, identical parallel directly opposed unit squares, spacing 1
cases.source: generator (closed form, S8 C-11 configuration) + Gauss-Legendre 16^4 check
cases.derivation: F = 2/(pi X Y) {ln sqrt((1+X^2)(1+Y^2)/(1+X^2+Y^2)) + X sqrt(1+Y^2) atan(X/sqrt(1+Y^2)) + Y sqrt(1+X^2) atan(Y/sqrt(1+X^2)) - X atan X - Y atan Y}

cases.quantity: view factor, perpendicular unit squares with a common edge
cases.source: generator (closed form, S8 C-14 configuration) + edge-integrated Duffy/Gauss-Legendre check
cases.derivation: Hottel closed form, W = H = 1 (see vf_perpendicular)
cases.note: the kernel is singular on the shared edge: the check integrates along the edge in closed form and uses a Duffy map for the corner

cases.quantity: summation rule inside a unit cube: F(opposite) + 4 F(adjacent)
cases.derivation: sum of view factors from one face of a closed cube = 1
